queries.name: rows
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM projected

queries.name: idade_status
queries.sql: SELECT "idade_status" AS status, count(*) AS n FROM projected GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

queries.name: uninterpreted_age_codes
queries.sql: SELECT "nu_idade_n" AS value, NULL AS unit, idade_status AS status, count(*) AS n FROM projected WHERE idade_status IN ('unsupported', 'invalid') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

queries.name: age_groups
queries.sql: SELECT NULL AS unit, idade_status AS status, min(idade_anos_completos) AS minimum, max(idade_anos_completos) AS maximum, count(*) AS n FROM projected GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
